personality_one_liner: A highly readable, function-first B2B interface where products and trust indicators take center stage against a crisp, high-contrast white and deep maroon canvas.

spacing.rule: Maintain crisp iOS-native breathing room. Use 'md' or 'lg' between sections. Avoid dense clustering.

do's: Use subtle glass effect on sticky top headers when content scrolls behind
Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar
Apply frosted overlays on hero banners to make text readable
dont's: Never use glass on product cards or list items
Never apply blur over form inputs

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: A momentary branding check that builds trust.
screens.layout: Full-screen surface. Center the Montez Infobyte logo (or bold typography wordmark). Subtle loading indicator at bottom.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #1F2937). Large white heading and subtext positioned in the bottom 40%. Prominent sticky primary CTA at safe-area bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: The main dashboard showing catalog breadth, featured products, and trust indicators.

states.loading: Skeleton carousel and skeleton product grids
states.error: Toast indicating connection error + retry button

screens.layout: Top sticky search bar (glass background). Content: 1. Hero banner carousel (Image + gradient scrim + text overlay). 2. Announcements row (brandTertiary surface). 3. Horizontal scrolling category chips. 4. Featured products grid (2-column). 5. Trust indicators block (verified partners, cities served).

screens.name: Products
screens.purpose: The core product catalog and discovery flow.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty box + 'No products found' + 'Clear Filters' CTA
states.error: Error icon + 'Failed to load catalog' + 'Retry' CTA

screens.layout: Sticky header with search input. Below it, a sticky horizontal list of category chips (Apparel, Corporate Gifts, Packaging). Main content is a 2-column grid of product cards. Product card: Image (top), Title (truncate 2 lines), Category label (sm, gray), MOQ, and Unit Price.

screens.name: ProductDetail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific SKU with a prominent RFQ action.

states.error: Error icon + 'Failed to load product' + 'Retry' CTA

screens.layout: Scrollable View. Top: Image gallery slider. Middle: Product Title, MOQ, Price, Category. Bottom: Description and Specifications. STICKY FOOTER: A fixed container at the bottom with a full-width 'Request Quote' (brandPrimary) button.

screens.name: RFQ
screens.purpose: Multi-field form for businesses to submit complex quote requests.

states.error: Inline field errors (red borders + small error text)

screens.layout: KeyboardAvoidingView containing a single-column form. Fields: Name, Email, Phone, Product Category (Dropdown/ActionSheet), Quantity, Description/Specs. Sticky submit CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Contact
screens.purpose: Easy access to dedicated account managers and support.
screens.layout: List of communication channels as cards (Phone, Email, WhatsApp, Office Address). Each card uses surfaceSecondary with a leading brand-tinted icon and trailing chevron.

screens.name: Account
screens.purpose: B2B buyer profile and order tracking.

states.empty: Logged out state: OTP Login form

screens.layout: If logged out: Clean OTP login flow (Phone input -> OTP input -> Verify). If logged in: Profile header (Initials avatar), followed by a list of options (My Quotes, Orders, Saved Addresses, Logout).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the #940a0a (maroon) brand color for primary actions, active tab states, and key visual accents. NEVER use blue, purple, or indigo anywhere.
Implement 5 bottom tabs: Home, Products, RFQ, Contact, Account.
B2B e-commerce relies heavily on details. Ensure product cards in the grid display Image, Title, Category, MOQ, and Price. Keep typography clean and readable.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' as the main typography. Rely on font-size for hierarchy, with a maximum font weight of 500.
For the RFQ form, utilize a sticky submit button wrapped in a KeyboardAvoidingView to ensure the user never loses the primary action while scrolling.
Include a horizontal scrolling chip list for categories (Apparel, Corporate Gifts, Packaging, etc.) on the Products and Home screens.
Any text overlaid on hero images MUST include a vertical linear-gradient scrim (Layer 1) below the text (Layer 2) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
